تنتحلوا (form VIII)
# تَنْتَحِلُوا (tantaḥilū) /tan.ta.ħi.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَحَلَ (intaḥala)
# تُنْتَحَلُوا (tuntaḥalū) /tun.ta.ħa.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَحَلَ (intaḥala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
